iconRule: Designed emblem masters (1600x1600) shipped scale-only at 512x512 — artwork never redrawn, cropped or recoloured.
appIconRule: The real full illustrated logo lockup (composited whole from logo-static.webp / logo-light.webp onto the pack tile) — byte-identical copies of the approved composites.
wallpaperRule: Clean pack grounds only — no logo baked or composited onto kit wallpapers; the whole logo ships as its own file. Device sizes are crop-to-fill renders of the approved ground.
